42033225.reason: a panel of fluorinated ASOs against one C9ORF72 repeat target, read out as reporter translation and foci burden. One target and a non-gapmer chemistry; no toxicity readout to train on.

41323796.reason: the SCAD conjugate delivery platform. Its screening optimises the accessory oligo architecture, not the sequence of a therapeutic oligo, so nothing maps onto a per-sequence endpoint.

42562700.reason: small-molecule screening against microglial ANXA2, with siRNA used only to confirm the target. Not an oligonucleotide screen.

42724647.reason: a review of in vitro CNS safety assays. Useful for choosing a readout for the CNS endpoint, but it reports no measurements of its own.

PMC13651819.reason: 24 gapmers designed against single-stranded SARS-CoV-2 regions, ~10 assayed. Read in full. Too few rows and a viral target, so not ingestible, but it is the one external result bearing on accessibility and is registered as gallo_sarscov2_shape_gapmers and cited in NEGATIVE_RESULTS entry 12.

PMC13669632.reason: title only; long ASOs perturbing the RNA exosome is a mechanism study of one construct class, with no per-sequence endpoint.

PMC13659513.reason: title only; TCR-T cell therapy in hepatocellular carcinoma. Not an oligonucleotide paper at all, matched on the liver vocabulary.

PMC13691374.reason: title only; NEAT1 and MYC degradation is target biology, not an oligo screen.

PMC12048806.reason: title only; dissects one lncRNA locus. 'Integrating datasets' refers to public transcriptomics, not oligonucleotide measurements.
